name: 陳怡倩
objective: This course introduces students to the practical use of artificial intelligence (AI) for cross-disciplinary data analysis and presentation. Students will learn how to leverage AI tools to collect, analyze, visualize, interpret, and present data in professional and personal contexts. Emphasis is placed on hands-on projects, ethical considerations, and translating AI outputs into actionable insights.

Week 2 The art of prompting & language learning
Week 3 AI search & mobile integration
Week 4 Media assistance
Week 5 Google workspace workflow automation
Week 6 Mastering Gemini Canvas
Week 7 (no class on Monday) TBA
Week 8 Mini individual presentations I

Week 14 AI storybooks & visual information design
Week 15 NotebookLM I: smart sourcing & interaction
Week 16 NotebookLM II: multi-modal outputs
Week 17 Final Project Presentations I
Week 18 Final Project Presentations II

課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
